name: What due diligence is critical when buying a luxury second home, especially one with unique features?

mainEntity.name: What due diligence is critical when buying a luxury second home, especially one with unique features?

acceptedAnswer.text: Critical due diligence for a luxury second home goes beyond standard inspections to include evaluations specific to high-value properties and local conditions. This might involve a detailed structural inspection, assessment of specialized systems like smart home technology or marine docks, and a thorough review of HOA documents for private communities. Understanding these reports is crucial before finalizing your purchase, and our team ensures you have all necessary information for informed decision-making.
